result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with consistent spacing and readable text. A few minor issues were found: a truncated restaurant name, a partially cut-off card in the carousel, and small low-contrast text in card metadata.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated at the right edge of the 'Fastest near you' carousel, with no visible ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add text-overflow ellipsis or ensure the card width accommodates full names, so users see the complete restaurant name.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' card image is cut off mid-card at the screen edge, which can look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek of the next card with a fade or edge indicator to make horizontal scrolling more discoverable.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text (delivery fees, times) is small and light gray, which may have low contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase text size or darken the gray used for delivery fee and time labels to improve readability.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom (with -20% badge) is cut off with no visible name, rating, or delivery info, appearing incomplete until scrolled.
issues.suggestion: This is likely just scroll position; consider ensuring minimum card content (name and rating) is visible above the fold.
